name: BlurInText
description: Headline that resolves word by word from a soft blur, fading and lifting each word into focus with a configurable stagger and initial blur radius.
a11yNotes: Renders a semantic h1/h2/h3/p carrying the full sentence in aria-label while the per-word spans are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion words render in their final, unblurred state with no animation.

defaultProps.text: Motion that feels considered, not decorated.

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay between consecutive words in seconds.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
